Average hydrogen-disordered Pn-3m single-site model from Gajda et al., IUCrJ 12, 288-294 (2025), doi:10.1107/S2052252525002581: O at 2a and half-occupied H at 8e. The paper cautions that the local disorder is more complex than this average model; it is used here for powder X-ray lines. The lattice is set to the default 300 K PVT-fit V0.

## Bezacier et al. (2014), PVT BM2

Identifier: `ice_vii_bezacier_2014_bm2_1`.

Availability: **Executable**.

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.


- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Bezacier; Journaux; Perrillat; Cardon; Hanfland; Daniel
    - **Year:** 2014
    - **Title:** Equations of state of ice VI and ice VII at high pressure and high temperature
    - **Source:** Journal of Chemical Physics
    - **Volume:** 141
    - **Locator:** 104505
    - **DOI:** 10.1063/1.4894421
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[2.55, 10.11\]
- **Reported temperature coverage (K):** \[300.5, 451.2\]

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 41.480265898 | 0.0332107813 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0 | 20.15 | 0.17 | Not listed |
| Thermal | alpha0 | 0.0001158 | 5.4e-06 | Not listed |
| Thermal | dK\_dT | 0.0 | Not reported | Yes |
| Thermal | Tr | 300.0 | Not reported | Yes |

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported
meaning; an absent error is unknown, and absence of covariance does not
establish statistical independence.

Joint PVT fit for pure H2O ice VII. Published molar V0=12.49(1) cm^3/mol is converted to the Z=2 unit cell. The second-order Birch-Murnaghan form fixes K0'=4; dK/dT was fixed to zero because no temperature dependence was detectable. The numeric domains give the extrema of the ice-VII measurements tabulated in the paper.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Frank et al. (2004), 300 K BM3

Identifier: `ice_vii_frank_2004_bm3_2`.

Availability: **Executable**.


- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Frank; Fei; Hu
    - **Year:** 2004
    - **Title:** Constraining the equation of state of fluid H2O to 80 GPa using the melting curve, bulk modulus, and thermal expansivity of Ice VII
    - **Source:** Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta
    - **Volume:** 68
    - **Locator:** 2781-2790
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.gca.2003.12.007
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported

Independent 300 K compression fit. Published molar V0=12.4(1) cm^3/mol is converted to the Z=2 cubic cell. The fit used all three BM3 variables simultaneously; the numeric pressure domain is the range of the authors' 300 K compression data.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
